edition_identity.work: 子平真詮 (title page: 秘本子平真詮)
edition_identity.author: 山陰沈燡燔孝瞻撰 (Shen Yifan, zi Xiaozhan, of Shanyin; TOC and body head both carry 山陰沈燡燔孝瞻撰)
edition_identity.print: Republican-era Shanghai typeset edition: title page reads 秘本子平真詮 / 沈孝瞻先生撰 / 附偉人星命錄・民國萬年曆 / 上海世界書局發行 (bottom row of title page reads 世界圖書館發行-style seal script; TOC lists the appendices as 新增 偉人星命錄 and 民國萬年書)
edition_identity.preface: Standard recension preface present at PDF pages 2-4, narrating discovery of Shen's 子平手錄三十九篇 via 章君安 in the 宛平沈明府 office, and calling the work 此談子平家眞詮也; signed 乾隆四十一年歲在丙申初夏同里後學胡焜倬雲甫謹識 (1776, Hu Kunzhuo, zi Yunfu — the 胡空甫 of received tradition)
edition_identity.date_of_this_print: 民國 (Republican) era, undated on title page; 民國萬年曆 appendix implies post-1912. This is a 世界書局 typeset reprint of the standard 1776 recension, NOT a Qing block print.
edition_identity.nlc_marks: NLC barcode '3 2167 7651 2' stamped above the preface frame on PDF page 2; handwritten shelf numbers top-left of same page
edition_identity.page_layout: one printed folio page per PDF page, text in frame, columns top-to-bottom right-to-left, running title 子平眞詮 plus folio number in the left margin
edition_identity.note: Preface says 手錄三十九篇 (39 chapters); TOC enumerates 47 論-titles because each 取運 chapter is listed separately, plus the two 新增 Republican appendices.

chapter_map.chapter: 序 (胡焜倬 preface, dated 乾隆四十一年丙申)

collation_notes: TOC (PDF p5) lists chapter 5 as 論日干合而不合 at first glance, but the second character is 十 in the same title style as its neighbours; received editions have 論十干合而不合 — body heading to be checked when reached.
Author name printed 沈燡燔 in TOC byline and preface (先生諱燡燔), matching the received name 沈燡燔 sometimes romanized via variant 沈铁燔/沈燡燔 confusion; courtesy name 孝瞻 confirmed.
